Kevin PM: Quick sync — we ran the enterprise listening session with 3 customers yesterday. Key asks: durable audit exports, BYOK escrow options, and retention controls. Need to prioritize for next sprint (2 weeks). Can we land on acceptance criteria and gating?
Maria P: Thanks. TL;DR of asks?
Kevin PM: Short: (1) Export all tenant audit logs in a forensically-sound format (chain of custody); (2) BYOK handshake + optional KMS escrow with audit trail; (3) Per-tenant retention TTL + legal-hold override. Customers want SLA for audit-search within 24 hrs for exported evidence.
Jonah: For exports: propose newline-delimited JSON with signed manifests, SHA256 checksums, and S3-compatible multipart URL. Should include schema v1/v2 headers.
Ashley (prod): +1. Also need an 'evidence_package' format that includes: logs, model version, routes, and policy snapshot. Searchability matters — indexing costs will go up if we keep search hot.
Derek (security): Important: BYOK escrow requires legal controls. We need an approval flow: escrow only available after signed DPA + admin-confirmed key rotation policy. Also HSM-backed wrapping key for escrow.
Kevin PM: Acceptance criteria draft:
- Exports: tenants can request export via Console/API; generated package contains signed manifest (SHA256), all audit events for window, and metadata; package downloadable and verifiable.
- BYOK: handshake flow documented; keys can be uploaded or linked via customer KMS; escrow option must record who/when/why in audit logs.
- Retention: tenant-level TTL with min/max bounds (e.g., 30d - 10y) and 'legal_hold' boolean that overrides TTL.
- GA gating: must pass two customers in beta + internal SOC2 evidence check.
Maria P: Add metrics: per-export generation time, package size, and cost estimate. We should set soft SLA: export ready within 6h for typical 30d window, hard SLA 24h for emergencies.
Jonah: Implementation notes: we can reuse current audit pipeline but add envelope signing and manifest generation. For retention UI, simple slider + ISO-8601 duration input. Sample config:
```
{"retention_policy": {"tenant_id": "t-123", "ttl_days": 3650, "legal_hold": false}}
```
Derek (security): Also require retention TTL immutable for exported evidence copies and for any legal hold we must freeze deletions at object level (S3 object lock / WORM).
Ashley (prod): For rollout, propose beta cohort = three midsize customers; also one enterprise with BYOK requirement. Add a 'beta_flag' and telemetry to monitor errors.
Kevin PM: Risks & tradeoffs:
- Cost: indexing/exporting could be expensive; option: cold archive + on-demand indexing for export.
- Complexity: BYOK + escrow increases legal burden. Might auto-offer escrow only after legal review.
- UX: too many knobs confuse customers.
Jonah: Minimal viable plan (MVP):
1) Export API + signed manifest (no UI) — 2-week sprint to build and test.
2) Retention TTL API + legal_hold flag — same sprint.
3) BYOK handshake doc + proof-of-concept (no escrow) — spike next sprint.
Derek (security): Must include automated tests for evidence integrity (checksum verification), and threat model review before beta.
Kevin PM: Action items:
- @Maria P: draft export schema & cost model by EOD Tue
- @Jonah: spike manifest signing implementation + perf estimate by Thu
- @Ashley (prod): design retention UI + beta onboarding flow by Fri
- @Derek (security): draft BYOK escrow policy + compliance checklist by next Wed
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline job created: #build-2376543210-export-spike
Maria P: Quick Q — what about SOC2/ISO evidence packaging: should we tag export packages with control IDs? e.g., CC7.1, CC9.2
Derek (security): Yes, package should include mapping to SOC2/ISO controls and attach evidence tags; we can auto-generate a 'controls.json' file inside package.
Jonah: For search SLA: offer two modes: 'archive_fast' (pay more) with pre-indexing, and 'archive_cold' (cheaper) with on-demand indexing; document tradeoffs.
Ashley (prod): UX suggestion: default retention to 180 days for new tenants; enterprise can request extended TTL via sales/contract.
Kevin PM: OK let's lock MVP scope to exports + retention APIs + evidence tagging. BYOK handshake goes to spike. Beta gating: 2 customers + security review. If no objections, I'll add to the sprint board.
Maria P: No objections from me. :+1:
Derek (security): Sounds good. Please include legal review step for any escrow offering.
Jonah: Will queue PRs into eng-runtime backlog.
Ashley (prod): I'll prep beta invite email template.
Kevin PM: Thanks everyone — closing thread. I'll post sprint card after lunch.
